Name: StreamDeck for Java
Description: Bridges a JVM client to the Stream Deck over a local WebSocket. Place Modspace keys to let a client paint the deck and receive presses, turns and taps.

io.github.stream-decked.modspace.Name: Modspace
io.github.stream-decked.modspace.Tooltip: Bridge key to the running Java client. Pressing it opens the client's surface; painted buttons forward presses to it.
